# pve_container_reboot (Action)

Reboots an LXC container by shutting it down and starting it again (`POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/status/reboot`). Pending configuration changes are applied by the reboot. Requires the `VM.PowerMgmt` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Reboots container 100 on pve1: shuts it down and starts it again,
# applying pending configuration changes. Waits up to 60 seconds for the
# shutdown phase. Invoke with:
#   terraform apply -invoke pve_container_reboot.reboot_ct100
invoke "pve_container_reboot" "reboot_ct100" {
  config {
    node    = "pve1"
    vmid    = 100
    timeout = 60
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the container runs on.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the container. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Optional

- `timeout` (Number) Wait maximal timeout seconds for the shutdown before the reboot proceeds. Must be 0 or greater; omit for the PVE default (60).
